My Story

2018 My start

I began debating at Brentwood High School in Brentwood, Tennessee. Brentwood was a small public-school program with limited resources, so I learned the technical side of national-circuit debate from the ground up. That foundation still shapes how I coach.

2018 — 2022 Proving it

By graduation in 2022, I was the first public-school debater in more than a decade to win the Tournament of Champions, reached No. 3 in the nation, and earned 9+ TOC bids as a competitor.

2022 — Present Coaching record

Since graduating, I have helped direct some of the largest debate camps and coaching programs in the country while working personally with dozens of teams. My students have reached quarterfinals or better at major national-circuit tournaments including Harvard, Berkeley, NSDA Nationals, and the Tournament of Champions, earning 80+ TOC bids combined.

2022 — Present My approach

I have helped novices become nationally ranked competitors by pairing technical depth with tactical adaptability. My goal is to equip each of my students with a skill set that will help them adapt to any team, judge, or tournament.
